# PR #177 round 3 correctness verdict

**PASS-WITH-NOTES** at `ff13b5ad6629cb63ceb3f5a8264c1442018b6cc7`.

Delta review from `b425d072b2bdd3f4b87708cf13c2e70091b13927`. **F001 and F002 are closed.**

The prime action path now receives queued instances only when its designated seat is not live. It uses the same live_holder boolean derived from the project designation for idle/call_on, rather than interpreting the deliberately empty prime assignment list as missing authority. The actual waiting-request count remains visible. Non-prime roles retain their prior filtering and action behavior.

The real-store regression first asserts one prime request is queued, then verifies no prime recovery action with a live designation. It tombstones that designated seat and verifies exactly one no-live-holder action, with only `pij project set fleet --prime '<seat>'`. The positive dead case prevents a broken, uniformly-empty action filter from passing the live negative case. The author reports the ungated mutant fails the live case; this was not rerun locally.

The merges leave community/directory.rs, community/picture.rs, directory_http.rs and CLI main.rs byte-identical to repair commit 2a133c5a. Consequently the prime-only legacy exclusion and the new action gate survive. #182 adds the canonical SeatId grammar/rendering helper and shared identity error handling; these do not rewrite the raw designation membership used by this view or reintroduce legacy rows as liveness. This is a merge-compatibility check, not a whole-PR #182 review.

Exact-head CI [42457966410](https://github.com/AI-Substrate/pij-fleet/actions/runs/42457966410) passed. JUnit artifact 13607684002 contains **2221 cases, zero failures/errors**, including the live/dead recovery pair, recent-live-legacy regression, CLI designation rendering, batch atomicity, no-project-docs fallback and merged seat-ID grammar/forged-input controls.

The prior F119 and assignment-refusal paths are unchanged. Notes remain proof scope only: mutation runs are author evidence, no local product execution or deployed canary was performed, and this does not attest caller-process origin or replace the separately owned security/performance reviews.

Checkout is clean/detached, remote head matches, and GitHub reports CLEAN. No new loop, poll, timer or launch in the repair; no local Cargo/tests, live probes, dependency changes or product edits by this reviewer. #184 remains separately held awaiting its new head.
